item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
"Yes, and?"

Agent Carter sat in stunned silence. "And?! What?"

Agent Henderson was slightly confused. "What?"

"I'm not getting this."

Agent Carter compulsively pulled his hair back. "Everything about it is wrong!"

I can't tell who is supposed to be saying what.

The probe description is good. Interesting. Makes a person wonder.

The second half with the conversation doesn't really do anything. It wanders and doesn't really get to the point.

In general, yes, I agree with the above.

item.content:encoded: The second half doesn't feel like it really has a beginning or end but the probe section was neat. Overall though it gives a good impression it's not deep enough to really engage a reader beyond cursory interest.

I wasn't a huge fan of the second part- the dialogue felt a bit forced, and it felt like it was an installment in a series I hadn't read- no character development.

The first part, though, was amazing. Pure, high-quality procedural porn. Upvoted for that.
